mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract_milestones ( contract_id, step_order, milestone_name, work_scope, amount, status ) VALUES ( #{contractId}, #{step}, #{title}, #{description}, #{amount}, 'WAITING' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE milestone_name = #{title}, work_scope = #{description}, amount = #{amount}
mapper.select: SELECT milestone_id as milestoneId, contract_id as contractId, step_order as step, milestone_name as title, work_scope as description, amount, due_date as dueDate, CAST(status AS CHAR) as status FROM contract_milestones WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} ORDER BY step_order
